intel-competitive-failure.round_2: PERFECT! Found the Qualcomm/Surface Pro X comparison—ecosystem problems (app compatibility, driver gaps, emulation limits) plus Apple's vertical integration advantage (decade of custom core work, macOS control, developer tools). Surface Pro X had the hardware but not the software ecosystem. Apple had BOTH. Also noted Intel's Alder Lake response needs follow-up.
